text:
ops-bot: Pager: metering.emitter — usage emit delay detected. ~20% of events not emitted to billing topic since 03:12Z. Several automated overage flags triggered. Paging on-call.

santosh: I'm on triage. please hold on customer comms until we have scope. checking pipeline backlog and emitter health.

maria: seeing ProducerRetry errors in emitter logs to kafka/billing-usage-raw. lots of 5xx from emitter -> upstream timeouts.

dmitri: @santosh @maria I'm SRE-oncall, joining. if we need a rollout I'll coordinate.

santosh: @dmitri thanks. @kelly can you run a quick affected-customer query and confirm any SLA/enterprise impact?

kelly: running a query now.
```sql
SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS missing_events
FROM usage_ingest
WHERE emitted_to_billing = false AND event_time >= '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY missing_events DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

kelly: top3 by missing events: cust-187 (~3.4M tokens), cust-42 (~1.1M tokens), cust-701 (touched automated overage email queue).

evan: tailing emitter pod logs now — seeing repeated `504 upstream timeout` and retry loops. looks like DB write latency spike / backpressure.

maria: can someone check redis/kv cache lag too? emitter uses prefix cache. commands: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/emitters/1 | jq .latency` and `kubectl logs -n infra emitter-1 --since=15m | grep WARN | tail -n 50`

santosh: mitigation plan (short):
1) disable automated overage alerts (prevent noisy customer emails)
2) flip emitter into fallback mode (batch-slow emitter) to safely drain backlog
3) if needed, controlled restart of emitter pods
moving to canary for 2.

dmitri: prepared rollout command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter --namespace=infra --selector=canary=true`

kelly: feature flag flipped: `billing.alerts.overage=false` :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident assigned: SRE-oncall (dmitri), billing-oncall (santosh), analytics (kelly). Severity: Sev2. Incident channel created: #inc-2256789012

maria: after switching to fallback emitter, drain rate improved from ~300 ev/s -> ~1200 ev/s. backlog shrinking.

santosh: customer impact summary: delayed usage reports for affected customers; automated overage emails queued but not billed. we should not contact customers until reconciliation.

kelly: drafting customer note: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting; no charges will be applied while we reconcile counts. We'll follow up within 24 hours." will paste draft here for review.

dmitri: started controlled restart of emitter pods. rotation in progress. emitter metrics look stable post-rotate but we see a 10% delta in token counts pre/post; need reconciliation job.

evan: queued backfill (dry-run): `/ops/backfill/emit-reconcile --start '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z' --end '2026-03-15T04:30:00Z' --dry-run`

maria: dry-run indicates ~1.8M events to emit. estimated full backfill ~22 minutes at current throughput.

santosh: run full backfill now. also applying temporary quota caps to avoid mid-backfill overage triggers.

kelly: applied quota cap to top-10 impacted customers, monitoring dashboards here: https://grafana.internal/d/emit/backlog (shared)

ops-bot: update: overage-alerting remains disabled until reconciliation completes.

maria: backfill running — progress 45%. seeing occasional `duplicate key` on emit but dedupe logic is preventing double-counts.

dmitri: post-backfill reconciliation plan: run SQL to compare raw vs emitted token sums. snippet: 
```sql
SELECT sum(raw.tokens) AS raw_tokens, sum(emitted.tokens) AS emitted_tokens
FROM raw_events raw
LEFT JOIN emitted_events emitted ON raw.event_id = emitted.event_id
WHERE raw.event_time >= '2026-03-15T03:00:00Z';
```

santosh: timeline (so far): incident opened 03:18Z, fallback 03:25Z, restart 03:40Z, backfill started 03:46Z, expected complete ~04:10Z. will hold customer comms until verification.

kelly: paging CS/Sales for cust-187 and cust-42, posting canned note in #customer-success.

evan: backfill completed at 04:09Z. reconciliation shows site-wide delta <0.05% except cust-187 has 0.7% variance — flagged for manual audit.

maria: manual audit finished, no erroneous charges recorded. re-enabling overage alerts now. :white_check_mark:

santosh: filing postmortem. preliminary root cause: emitter retry loop + DB timeout caused by unrelated reindex job on infra DB which increased write latency. owners: infra-team + emitter-service. action items: add circuit-breaker on emitter retries, improve backpressure metrics, split alerting for delayed emits vs count drift, and ensure feature-flag path for overage alerts.

ops-bot: Incident resolved: Sev2 -> resolved at 04:24Z. Tags: metering, billing, emit-lag, backfill.

maria: adding follow-ups to the incident doc: https://confluence.internal/incidents/2256789012

santosh: thanks all. I'll kick off postmortem draft and will assign owners to action items.

kelly: leaving notes for support handoff to handle any incoming customer messages — will track in the postmortem. :spiral_note_pad:
